title: UPPER PUSH + POSTURE
subtitle: TUESDAY KIND. OPEN CHEST. EASY SHOULDERS.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Tuesday is upper push and posture — a gentle little break from the desk. About eleven minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Open chest, quiet shoulders, and you showed up. Enjoy your Tuesday — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: WALL PUSH UPS
exercises.cue: Stand facing a clear wall, feet about a step back, hands on the wall at shoulder height. Soft belly, easy elbows. Bend the elbows to bring the chest a little closer, then press away with control. Keep the range small and kind. Step closer to the wall to make it easier. Smaller bend is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Wall push ups. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, hands on the wall, bend the elbows a little, then press away. Smaller range is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Thirty seconds. Soften the shoulders. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Wall push ups done. Nicely done.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD PRESS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Light hand weights optional — empty hands are fine. Start with hands by the shoulders, press gently up toward the ceiling only as high as feels kind, then lower with control. Soft neck, no shrugging. Stop short of any sharp shoulder pinch. Smaller press is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated overhead press. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, press gently up only as high as feels kind, then lower. Empty hands are fine. Soft neck.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the shoulders. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Light hand weights optional — empty hands are fine. Reach the arms forward softly, then draw the elbows back as if squeezing a soft cushion between the shoulder blades. Soft neck, chest open. Smaller squeeze is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, reach forward softly, then draw the elbows back and open the chest. Soft neck. Empty hands are fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the upper back. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Hinge gently from the hips and reach the hands forward toward the floor or your shins — only as far as feels kind. Soft neck, easy breath. Hold about twenty seconds, then stack tall again. Smaller reach is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach. Two holds of about twenty seconds. Soft belly, hinge gently from the hips, reach only as far as feels kind. Soft neck.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the back. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Forward reach done. That's the session — lovely work.
